verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/correctness_gate.py:715-725 (overlay_filed_periods) serves INR exchange-filed revenue_ttm/net_income_ttm (exchange_financials.py:74 'Sizes in INR') over Yahoo's sizes but leaves Fundamentals.financial_currency as set by sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:476-488,977 from Yahoo financialCurrency (USD for INFY.NS). Every consumer formats statement sizes in financial_currency, so INR sums are presented as USD. The 'disagrees' test at correctness_gate.py:722-724 also compares the USD provider figure with the INR filed sum across currencies. For SIFY itself, every consumer labels INR correctly (the claim's SIFY argument is refuted); the entry's symptom reproduces on INFY.NS.
verdicts.fix_shape: Fix once in overlay_filed_periods, which every consumer routes through via financial_currency. When the overlay serves any filed size, set the statement currency to the filing currency: financial_currency=None if currency=='INR' else 'INR'. Withhold, with a typed reason as _withhold_mixed_basis_ratios does, any un-overlaid Yahoo statement size still on the old basis (free_cash_flow on INFY.NS, Yahoo USD 3.17B), so it does not flip to a false INR label. Run the 30% divergence check only when both figures are on the same currency basis, and otherwise state the basis difference. No FX conversion: there is no stated-rate source and D-B2-3 chose withhold over convert. Labelling at each consumer is the wrong layer (six consumers trusting one lying field).
